t: In front of you is a bronze statue of Saint Volodymyr, standing on the corner of Holland Park and Holland Park Avenue. It was made in 1988 by the Canadian-Ukrainian sculptor Leo Mol, and unveiled on the twenty-ninth of May that year. It marks one thousand years since the Christianisation of Kievan Rus'. Volodymyr was Grand Prince of Kiev from 978 until his death in 1015, and both the Catholic and Eastern Orthodox churches made him a saint. Later in 1988, Mol put up another statue of him in Rome.
